proof_body:
by
  intro R _ g q₁ q₂ r₁ r₂ hg h₁ h₂ h
  obtain ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ := Polynomial.div_modByMonic_unique (f := g * q₁ + r₁) q₁ r₁ hg ⟨add_comm _ _, h₁⟩
  obtain ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ := Polynomial.div_modByMonic_unique (f := g * q₁ + r₁) q₂ r₂ hg ⟨by rw [h, add_comm], h₂⟩
  exact ⟨a₁.symm.trans a₂, b₁.symm.trans b₂⟩
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (g q₁ q₂ r₁ r₂ : Polynomial R), g.Monic → r₁.degree < g.degree → r₂.degree < g.degree → g * q₁ + r₁ = g * q₂ + r₂ → q₁ = q₂ ∧ r₁ = r₂
